title: Normalization and Pooling
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Prepare input CSV
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file listing each source well and the RSB volume to pool (format: "well,volume rsb" e.g., A1,200 B1,15). This custom normalization pooling protocol accepts up to 12 source wells into a single pooling tube.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the provided fields before running the script.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any needed labware JSON files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map, placing all labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the deck’s labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App’s calibration routine (refer to support articles if needed).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the normalization and pooling procedure.
